mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE rise does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS drop does not correlate with subsequent demand weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% over 3 months signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO rise does not correlate with subsequent supply-side strength.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% YoY, the combination signals a potential overheating economy with loose monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: loose monetary policy with inflationary pressure
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of low FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 over 3 months signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or PAYEMS decline does not correlate with subsequent labor market weakness.

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% YoY and Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) drop by more than 1% MoM, the combination signals a significant demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% YoY and RSAFS drops > 1% MoM
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of HOUST and RSAFS does not correlate with subsequent demand weakness.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1%, or the always-on signal does not correlate with subsequent positive returns.
